description: Land Acquisition - Hanwella, Badulla D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations for public purpose acquisition. While it mentions a government minister's name and title, the core content focuses entirely on land matters (property descriptions, boundaries, acquisition declarations) rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. This fits the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
